faqs.q: Which package do I need?
faqs.a: 1 camera suits club matches and single courts. 3 cameras suits finals, tournaments and national events, and anything with commentary.

faqs.q: Can we book the whole season?
faqs.a: Yes. Choose Season when you book: 10 matches, same crew, and 15% off every match.

faqs.q: Is it a national or international match?
faqs.a: Book Full day. National and international matches need the full set-up and run time.

faqs.q: Where does the stream go?
faqs.a: YouTube, Facebook and your website, all at once. We can stream to your own channel: add us as a manager or send your stream key.

faqs.q: Can the stream be private?
faqs.a: Yes. We can stream unlisted, so only people with the link can watch.

faqs.q: Do we need internet at the venue?
faqs.a: No. 4G internet is built into our kit. If the venue has a cable line, we use it as a backup.

faqs.q: What do we need to have ready?
faqs.a: A power point within 20 metres of the camera spot, and access for our crew 60 minutes before start.

faqs.q: How do we get player graphics?
faqs.a: Add your teams and players to the FFP app. It is free, and your stream then shows each player with photo, number and stats.

faqs.q: How do we add sponsor logos?
faqs.a: Send your logos as PNG files at least 48 hours before. They go on the scoreboard and full-screen at breaks.

faqs.q: Can we use our own commentator?
faqs.a: Yes. On the 3-camera package they plug a headset into our commentary desk. Or pick one of ours on the Talent page.

faqs.q: What if the match runs over time?
faqs.a: Up to 30 minutes over is included. Longer is charged as an extra hour.

faqs.q: Do we keep the recording?
faqs.a: Yes. The full recording is yours. Download link within 24 hours.

faqs.q: What about several courts or a multi-day tournament?
faqs.a: Use Get an estimate. Tell us the days, courts and schedule, and the estimate is built straight away.

faqs.q: How long until I get my footage?
faqs.a: All raw footage within 48 hours. Edited films within 5 days.

faqs.q: Is the footage edited?
faqs.a: The booking includes all raw footage. Add a Highlights film or Social clips for edited videos.

faqs.q: What format do I get?
faqs.a: 4K MP4 files by download link. Social clips come in vertical format for Instagram, TikTok and Reels.

faqs.q: Can you film interviews on the day?
faqs.a: Yes. Add Interviews and we set up a lit, miked spot with your logo backdrop.

faqs.q: Can I ask for changes to the edit?
faqs.a: Yes, one round of changes is included on every edited film.

faqs.q: Do you add music?
faqs.a: Yes. Edited films and clips use licensed music, safe for social media.

faqs.q: Who owns the video?
faqs.a: You do. Post it anywhere, as often as you like.

faqs.q: What should I send before the day?
faqs.a: The schedule, the key moments you want, and any people to interview.

faqs.q: Can you cover two things happening at once?
faqs.a: Add a Second videographer so both are covered.

faqs.q: Do you film with drones?
faqs.a: Drone filming needs a UAE permit. Ask for it in Get an estimate and we quote it.

faqs.q: Where do you record?
faqs.a: At your venue: clubhouse, office or event. We bring the full set.

faqs.q: What room do we need?
faqs.a: A quiet room with space for a table and chairs. Our kit runs on battery, so power is a bonus, not a must.

faqs.q: How many people can be on?
faqs.a: Up to 4 hosts and guests, each with their own microphone, filmed from three angles.

faqs.q: How long does set-up take?
faqs.a: About 45 minutes. We arrive early so you start on time.

faqs.q: How many episodes can we record?
faqs.a: 2 hours suits one or two episodes. A full day suits a series of four or more.

faqs.q: Do we get video as well as audio?
faqs.a: Yes. You get the audio and all three camera angles.

faqs.q: Can you edit and publish it for us?
faqs.a: Add Edited episode and we deliver files ready for Spotify, Apple Podcasts and YouTube.

faqs.q: Can we stream it live?
faqs.a: Yes. Add Livestream the podcast and it goes live on YouTube or Facebook while you record.

faqs.q: Can you make clips for social media?
faqs.a: Add Social clips for 5 vertical clips of the best moments.

faqs.q: Who owns the recording?
faqs.a: You do. Publish it anywhere.

rentFaq.q: What do I need to rent?
rentFaq.a: Your Emirates ID, which you leave with us at pick-up or delivery. You also agree to pay for anything lost or damaged while the gear is with you.

rentFaq.q: Can someone show us how it works?
rentFaq.a: Add Set-up and handover. An FFP operator sets everything up at your venue and shows your team how to run it.

rentFaq.q: Can you run it for us instead?
rentFaq.a: Yes. Book a livestream and our crew brings and runs the gear.

rentFaq.q: Do you give a discount for longer rentals?
rentFaq.a: Yes. 10% off for 3 to 6 days, and 20% off for 7 days or more.

rentFaq.a: It needs an experienced operator. Most clients add Set-up and handover, or book our crew to run it.
